zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.5** 把 `0.0.5-beta.1` 到 `0.0.5-beta.4` 的 Goal 工作台、结果验收和无头 CLI 收成正式版。
全局工作台按 Goal Thread 分组待验收结果；结果抽屉复用当前对话，可一次接受整条线程。
产物预览能用记住的编辑器打开文件，源码有语法高亮；验收完成后再收起卡片。
新增无头 `peer exec`：不打开 TUI，按提供方消歧模型，默认不截断轮次。

zh.title: 新功能
items: **全局工作台 Goal Thread**：待验收结果按线程分组，父子轮次拍成同级列表；点轮次会跳到对应消息。
**结果抽屉**：复用当前对话界面，可最大化；同一线程上的待验收项可一次全部接受。
**主要产物**：任务概览汇总代码、图片和文件变更，hover 可看 diff 或缩略图；源码预览复用 highlight.js。
**拆分打开**：预览顶栏可用上次记住的编辑器打开当前文件，也能另选已安装应用，或打开所在文件夹。
**无头 `peer exec`**：在当前目录直接跑一轮 Agent；按提供方消歧模型名，不传 `--max-turns` 时不人为截断。
**`read_file` 行范围**：支持 `start_line` / `end_line`，按行返回带行号的切片。

zh.title: 优化
items: 思考过程改成单行实时滚动，默认收起；首次启动直接进入聊天。
任务产物显示真实文件名和 +N/−M，行号跟 unified diff 对齐。
前台 `local.shell.exec` 在同一会话里保持 cwd 和环境。
长对话不再打开成空白间隔；跳到某条消息后再发送，不再滚回去并闪回旧目标。

zh.title: 修复
items: 会话 / 结果抽屉恢复左侧圆角，最大化时不再被裁成直角。
验收完成后的卡片进入历史；打开历史不再把抽屉卡死。
编辑器菜单图标和箭头不再丢。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本版 GitHub Release 附带 CLI 归档（与 Desktop 同 tag / 同版本）。
可通过 `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`（或 `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`）安装正式通道版本；`postinstall` 会拉取本版归档。
也可手动解压归档，将目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 校验后运行 `peer`。
CLI 与 Desktop 继续共享 `~/.peer-agent` 下的会话和设置。

en.title: Notes
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.5** graduates the `0.0.5-beta.1`–`0.0.5-beta.4` Goal workbench, review drawer, and headless CLI into a stable release.
The global workbench groups pending reviews by Goal Thread; the result drawer reuses the current conversation and can accept a whole thread at once.
Artifact previews open files in a remembered editor with syntax highlighting; review cards stay open until delivery actually finishes.
New headless `peer exec` runs a turn without the TUI, disambiguates models by provider, and does not cut off turns by default.

en.title: What's New
items: **Goal Thread in the global workbench**: pending reviews group by thread, with parent/child rounds as a flat list; clicking a round jumps to that message.
**Result drawer**: reuses the current conversation, can maximize, and can accept every pending item on the same thread.
**Primary artifacts**: the task overview lists code, images, and file changes; hover shows a diff or thumbnail; Source mode reuses highlight.js.
**Split open**: the preview toolbar can open the current file in the last-used editor, pick another installed app, or reveal the folder.
**Headless `peer exec`**: run one Agent turn in the current directory; model names are disambiguated by provider, and omitting `--max-turns` does not invent a cutoff.
**`read_file` line ranges**: `start_line` / `end_line` return a numbered slice.

en.title: Improvements
items: Thinking is a single scrolling line and stays collapsed by default; first launch goes straight to chat.
Artifacts show real filenames and +N/−M, with line numbers aligned to the unified diff.
Foreground `local.shell.exec` keeps cwd and environment across calls in the same session.
Long conversations no longer open as blank gaps; sending after a jump-to-message no longer replays the old scroll target.

en.title: Fixes
items: Session / result drawers keep their left-side corner radius when maximized.
Accepted cards move into history; opening history no longer freezes the drawer.
Editor menu icons and chevrons no longer go missing.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release includes CLI archives (same tag / version as Desktop).
Install the stable channel with `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest` (or `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`); `postinstall` downloads this release's archive.
Alternatively, unpack an archive manually, add its directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version`, and then run `peer`.
CLI and Desktop continue to share sessions and settings under `~/.peer-agent`.
